properties.name: cookie.secure
properties.description: Whether to set the Secure flag on auth cookies. Set to false for local HTTP development, true in production (HTTPS).

properties.name: courier.service.url
properties.description: Base URL of the courier microservice.

properties.name: courier.service.timeout-ms
properties.description: HTTP timeout in milliseconds for calls to the courier microservice.

properties.name: courier.service.jwt.private-key
properties.description: PKCS8 PEM content of the RSA private key used to sign RS256 service-to-service JWTs sent to the courier service. Set via COURIER_SERVICE_PRIVATE_KEY env var / GitHub secret.

properties.name: courier.service.jwt.issuer
properties.description: JWT issuer claim included in courier service tokens.

properties.name: courier.service.jwt.expiry-seconds
properties.description: TTL in seconds for courier service JWTs. Keep short — tokens are single-use effectively.

properties.name: inactivity.block-after-days
properties.description: Number of days without any login after which a customer account is automatically suspended.

properties.name: otp.expiry-minutes
properties.description: How long (in minutes) a generated OTP code remains valid before expiring.

properties.name: otp.resend-cooldown-seconds
properties.description: Minimum seconds the user must wait before requesting a new OTP of the same type.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to sign and verify JWT access tokens. Must be kept private.

properties.name: jwt.access-token-validity-minutes
properties.description: Lifetime of a JWT access token in minutes.

properties.name: jwt.refresh-token-validity-days
properties.description: Lifetime of a refresh token in days.

properties.name: google.client-id
properties.description: Google OAuth2 client ID from Google Cloud Console.

properties.name: google.client-secret
properties.description: Google OAuth2 client secret from Google Cloud Console.

properties.name: google.redirect-uri
properties.description: OAuth2 redirect URI registered in Google Cloud Console.

properties.name: apple.team-id
properties.description: Apple Team ID from Apple Developer account.

properties.name: apple.client-id
properties.description: Apple Client ID (Service ID) from Apple Developer account.

properties.name: apple.key-id
properties.description: Apple Key ID (Private Key identifier) from Apple Developer account.

properties.name: apple.private-key
properties.description: Apple Private Key (.p8 file content) used to sign Apple Client Secret.

properties.name: apple.redirect-uri
properties.description: OAuth2 redirect URI registered in Apple Developer account.

properties.name: twilio.sendgrid.api-key
properties.description: Twilio SendGrid API key used to send transactional emails.

properties.name: twilio.sendgrid.from-email
properties.description: Verified sender email address used as the From address for all outgoing emails.

properties.name: twilio.sendgrid.from-name
properties.description: Display name shown alongside the from email address.

properties.name: twilio.account-sid
properties.description: Twilio Account SID used for SMS OTP delivery.

properties.name: twilio.auth-token
properties.description: Twilio Auth Token used to authenticate SMS API requests.

properties.name: twilio.phone-number
properties.description: Twilio phone number used as the sender for outbound SMS messages.

properties.name: paymob.api-key
properties.description: Paymob API key. Set via PAYMOB_API_KEY environment variable.

properties.name: paymob.secret-key
properties.description: Paymob secret key for server-side authentication. Set via PAYMOB_SECRET_KEY env var.

properties.name: paymob.public-key
properties.description: Paymob public key used on the client side. Set via PAYMOB_PUBLIC_KEY env var.

properties.name: paymob.hmac-secret
properties.description: HMAC secret used to verify Paymob webhook signatures. Set via PAYMOB_HMAC_SECRET env var.

properties.name: paymob.base-url
properties.description: Base URL for Paymob API calls. Set via PAYMOB_BASE_URL env var.

properties.name: paymob.notification-url
properties.description: Paymob will POST transaction webhooks to this URL. Set via PAYMOB_NOTIFICATION_URL env var.

properties.name: paymob.redirection-url
properties.description: Paymob will redirect the user browser to this URL after payment attempt. Set via PAYMOB_REDIRECTION_URL env var.

properties.name: paymob.card.integration-id
properties.description: Paymob integration ID for card payments. Set via PAYMOB_CARD_INTEGRATION_ID env var.

properties.name: paymob.card.iframe-id
properties.description: Paymob iframe ID for card payment UI embedding. Set via PAYMOB_CARD_IFRAME_ID env var.

properties.name: paymob.tabby.integration-id
properties.description: Paymob integration ID for Tabby (buy now pay later). Set via PAYMOB_TABBY_INTEGRATION_ID env var.

properties.name: paymob.tamara.integration-id
properties.description: Paymob integration ID for Tamara (buy now pay later). Set via PAYMOB_TAMARA_INTEGRATION_ID env var.

properties.name: firebase.enabled
properties.description: Set to true to enable Firebase Admin SDK and FCM push notifications. Requires credentials via firebase.service-account-json or firebase.service-account-key.

properties.name: firebase.service-account-key
properties.description: Spring Resource path to the Firebase service account JSON file. In production this is file:/firebase/service-account.json (mounted from the VPS via Docker volume). For local dev use classpath:firebase-service-account.json.

properties.name: outbox.poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Interval in milliseconds between outbox publisher job runs — polls for PENDING events and publishes them to RabbitMQ.
